name: GOLDEN BUDDHA IN DHYANA MUDRA
community: Classical Buddhist Monastic Guild of Nalanda & Sarnath
approximate_period: Gupta / Pala Classical Era (c. 5th–8th Century CE)
traditional_use: Sacred contemplative icon for monastic meditation (Dhyana / Vipassana) and ritual consecration.
cultural_significance: Depicts Gautama Buddha in supreme meditative absorption (Samadhi) in Padmasana with hands in Dhyana Mudra. The radiant halo (Prabhavali) and flame Ushnisha signify transcendent wisdom, equanimity, and inner awakening.
associated_practice: Dhyana meditation, Vesak sanctification, and circumambulation (Pradaksina).
contributor: Dr. Anandamaya Shastri, Senior Buddhist Archaeologist

surface_appearance.value: Smooth classical cast bronze with gilded gold leaf patina and subtle antique burnish

texture.value: Fibrous cord impression with embossed tribal lozenges

shape.value: Seated Buddha in Padmasana on Tiered Double-Lotus Base with Prabhavali Halo

approximate_period.value: circa 5th–8th Century CE (Gupta–Pala Classical Golden Age)

condition.value: Intact, light superficial cupric oxidation along base

craft_technique.value: Dhokra Lost-Wax (Cire Perdue) casting with clay core

condition_notes.cracks: None observed in primary brass structural envelope.
condition_notes.breakage: Minor 2mm dent on outer lower pedestal flange, does not compromise stability.
condition_notes.surface_damage: Superficial verdigris patina near lower rim, chemically stable.
condition_notes.discoloration: Natural darkened bronze oxidation inside neck cavity due to historical offerings.
condition_notes.missing_parts: Original ritual coconut and mango leaf brass lid is intact and seated.
condition_notes.wear: Handling burnish on spherical grip curvature consistent with ritual veneration.
condition_notes.restoration: Cleaned with non-acidic ethanol swab by conservation team in 2024.

oral_knowledge.speaker: Dr. Anandamaya Shastri
oral_knowledge.status: AI-assisted / Verified by Tribal Research Cell
oral_knowledge.transcript: यह ध्यानस्थ बुद्ध प्रतिमा गुप्त और पाल कालीन धातुशिल्प का अनुपम शिखर है। भगवान बुद्ध पद्मासन में विराजित हैं और उनके दोनों हाथ ध्यान मुद्रा में गोदी में रखे हैं। सिर पर उष्णीष और दोनों कानों के लंबे कुंडल त्याग और परम प्रज्ञा को दर्शाते हैं।
oral_knowledge.translation: This seated Buddha statue in Dhyana Mudra represents the pinnacle of classical Gupta and Pala metallurgy. Gautama Buddha is seated in Padmasana with both hands reposed in Dhyana Mudra in his lap. The cranial Ushnisha and elongated earlobes symbolize supreme renunciation and enlightened wisdom.
